name: filter-lists
description: Single-source universe for the lists a source publishes for its filterable fields. The filing twin has nothing real behind it: seven invented notes, each filed in folders that form a tree and shared with a group that has members. Its fixture cabinet.json seeds the folders and groups, which a test then renames, moves and deletes in memory between syncs; filter-lists.e2e.test.ts asserts the gateway's stored lists follow through ordinary syncs while no note is sent again.
